race.comment: BENEVAC (1) nice type who can get the better of these deep into the prep. Taken to the front and never headed with a dominant victory over this course and distance. Adept in all going and winning apprentice retains the mount. Has options from the draw and can win again. ZOUFAME (10) heavily backed into favouritism to beat BENEVAC last start but had no answer in the straight with a tiring second over 1100m at this track. Meets him better at the weights and can finish closer today. EXIT FEE (3) had been racing well and will relish the fast tempo in this easier contest. Back in trip and look for him launching late. ALEPPO PINE (4) went back from the wide gate and was a total forgive second-up when seventh over this trip at Rosehill in BM78 class. Finds a weaker race and don't dismiss. SIR LES (9) just under six-weeks between runs when he folded up in the straight to run fifth over this distance at Rosehill in Midway grade. Fitter now with a key jockey change. Place best.
